entities.name: Wala'a Essam al-Boushi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Walaa Issam ElBoushi is a Sudanese activist who became the Sudanese Minister of Youth and Sport in early September 2019 in the Transitional Cabinet of Prime Minister Abdalla Hamdok, during the 2019 Sudanese transition to democracy.
